text:
Marie: Heads-up — planning a staged rollout for Python SDK v2 (breaking change). The streaming handler signature is moving from sync callbacks to async callbacks. This will break in-app wrappers. Need migration plan, canary, telemetry, and console changes. Thoughts?

Alex: Oof. Which exact signature change? Can you paste example?

Marie: Old vs new (rough):
```
# v1
def on_chunk(chunk):
    process(chunk)
client.subscribe_stream(on_chunk)

# v2
async def on_chunk(chunk):
    await process(chunk)
await client.subscribe_stream(on_chunk)
```
This is causing the biggest friction.

Jon: How will this affect server-side adapters that proxy streams (webhooks, internal gateways)? We should also add sdk_version to telemetry so we can filter errors.

Sasha: Console/UX question: do we need an opt-in toggle on API keys page to block v2 tokens for older apps? Alternatively a per-route rollout flag like `sdk_compat` might help.

Alex: Proposal: publish v2 as a beta wheel `redwood-python==2.0b1`, add a runtime feature flag `allow_py2_streaming_async`. Do a 10% hosted traffic canary + enable for a few Dedicated test tenants.

Marie: Agree on the feature-flag approach. Also want a migration guide + simple codemod to convert sync->async handlers. DevEx can own the codemod if eng provides clear AST diffs.

Jon: Telemetry checklist: include `sdk_name` and `sdk_version` on every request, emit a `streaming_error` metric with labels (sdk_version, route, model). Also, server can send a deprecation header `X-Supports-Py2Streams` so older clients warn.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: created rollout policy `redwood/devex/py-sdk-v2-canary` — scheduled 2024-07-30T18:00Z.

Sasha: Console needs a small dashboard: errors by `sdk_version` and `streaming_error_rate` over time. If we can standardize metric names (`streaming_errors`, `streaming_latency_ms`) I can wire the graphs and alerts.

Marie: Plan quick timeline: draft prom & console changes this week, codemod next week, beta publish next Tue, start canary Thu. @Alex can you lead beta publish + coordinate with eng-oncall?

Alex: Yes, I can take beta publish and coordinate oncall. I'll open the PR to add the feature-flag header + telemetry this afternoon. :thumbsup:

Sasha: One more — let's add a brief note in the rollouts UI: "Python SDK v2 changes streaming handler semantics; enabling for a subset of traffic will surface migration issues." Small copy and a link to migration guide should reduce support noise.

Marie: Good call. I'll draft the blurb and the migration guide outline and share in #devex-docs.
